spans.s: SV0113 जरण शक्ति jaraṇa śakti Individual capacity to digest the consumed food. Peoples who indulge in exercise or any kind of physical activity he will be having adequate digestive fire for proper digestion of taken food.
RS0092 जरा jarā A stage indicating the age
BP0117 जरायुज jarāyuja viviparous class of creatures
RS0088 जारण jāraṇa A mercurial process made to digest without increment in the weight of the initial mercury.
